::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 8\
**Prep time:** 10 minutes\
**Cook time:** 30 minutes

[Appetizer]{.badge .badge-apps} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*This will always win the potluck.*

## Ingredients

- 1 package frozen spinach (thawed, drained)
- 1 can artichokes (drained, chopped)
- 1 clove garlic (diced)
- 1 cup sour cream
- 1 cup mayo
- 1 block cream cheese
- 1 tsp lemon juice
- ¾ cup green onion (chopped)
- mozzarella (for topping)
- salt (to taste)
- black pepper (to taste)

## Instructions

*Preheat the oven to 350°F.*

1. Mix all the ingredients except the mozzarella together in a baking dish.
2. Top the mixture with the mozzarella.
3. Bake until golden brown and bubbling on the sides.
4. Serve with chips or toasted bread.
